questions.q: Which of the following is a copolymer?
questions.explain: Buna-N is made from two different monomers, 1,3-butadiene and acrylonitrile. Teflon, PVC and PAN each come from a single monomer, so they are homopolymers even though they contain atoms other than C and H.

questions.q: The correct increasing order of intermolecular forces is:
questions.explain: Neoprene is an elastomer (weakest forces), PVC a thermoplastic (intermediate) and Nylon-6 a fibre (strongest, hydrogen bonding).

questions.q: Which polymer is a condensation polymer?
questions.explain: Glyptal is a polyester from ethylene glycol and phthalic acid, formed with loss of water. Polystyrene, neoprene and PMMA have all-carbon main chains and are addition polymers.

questions.q: Which pairing of polymer and chain structure is correct?
questions.explain: Bakelite is a cross-linked network formed from phenol and formaldehyde. LDPE is branched, HDPE and PVC are linear.
